title: Interview: John Lennon for BBC Radio 1 | 1973
content:
John Lennon gave an interview to BBC Radio 1 on 14 November 1973.

It was to promote his Mind Games album. The interviewers were Johnny Beerking and Charlie Gillett.

The audio was used in a number of shows, but mainly appeared in The Story Of Pop, a 26-part show which ran from September 1973 to March 1974.

Lennon spoke about various subjects including his musical influences, his time in The Beatles, songwriting, and working with Phil Spector.

An exchange about Mind Games was used on Sounds Of The 70s on 23 November.
